title.narrative: UNICEF support helped improve outcomes for women and children by supporting transformation of the primary healthcare system. A total 317,232 outreach sessions were held in 6,609 settlements across eight states, reaching 1,886 underserved communities. In 10 states with 52 zero-dose LGAs, 146,000 vulnerable individuals were enrolled to access affordable healthcare.
